name: dumbbell seated close grip press
description: A seated overhead press with the dumbbells held close together, palms facing in. It works the front delts and triceps.
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with back support, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Hold them close together with palms facing each other.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and ribs down.
Lower slowly back to your shoulders.
Do not arch your lower back.
